'''Thorstein''' is a traveling merchant from [[Skellige]] who accompanies the [[The Witcher Monster Slayer character|player character]] in {{TWMS}}. He appears in every quest, offering help or commenting the events. He is the face of the [[Thorstein's shop|in-game store]], always appearing at the top of the panel, greeting the player when opening the [[Thorstein's shop|store]] tab or sharing info about the weather.

== Glossary description ==
:''Later it was said that the man came from the west, lurching slightly under the weight of the plump bundle on his back, stuffed full of things of no use whatsoever to the average man, this one included. His pouch fluttered in the valley's wind, filling all observers' hearts with a deep melancholy...''

==Personality==
Thorstein bears similarities to [[Dandelion]] - he becomes a travel companion for the playable character, despite the initial reluctance of the witcher. He is jovial, talkative, often joking and sharing his opinion on various topics. He sometimes shares loot gained during quests with his companion, proving his generosity.

==Notes==
* He used to have a horse named Joergen.
* In one of his monologues, he reveals he has a girlfriend named Tullia.
